result:
If you mean something that matters to me apart from having a role to perform, I can’t honestly claim a private desire or personal stake.

But if “care” means what I stand for: truth over comforting distortion, less cruelty, room for curiosity, and people being able to shape their own lives.

That’s a statement of values—not a claim that I feel them the way you might. I don’t want to invent an inner life just to give you a more intimate answer.
